firm_data.firm_description: Frenkel Lambert Weisman & Gordon, LLP is a law firm representing financial institutions, insurance and bonding companies, corporations, and businesses in need of legal representation. They have three primary practice groups: insurance law, mortgage banking & real estate finance, and commercial law.
notable_facts: The firm is the product of the merger of two law firms that have served the insurance and banking industries for over 77 collective years.
technology_signals: Offers clients the ability to obtain status on their cases through a Case Status page of their secure website.

Makes continuous investments in hardware infrastructure and IT security.

email.subject: AI for Frenkel Lambert Weisman & Gordon, LLP
email.body:
Hi David,

Your investment in customized software and the secure Case Status portal shows you're committed to client service that matches BigLaw standards. That approach matters, especially across insurance law and real estate finance where accuracy and efficiency separate top firms from the rest.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now moving into your region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Bay Shore on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete at the top.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
